name: ctrl-kanb
description: Application locale pour piloter des tâches avec Codex et Claude Code.

scripts.test: npm run test:static && npm run test:ui && npm run test:native && npm run test:privacy
scripts.test:static: node Scripts/xss-scan.js && node Scripts/i18n-scan.js && node Scripts/wiring-audit.js && node Scripts/test-windows-contract.js
scripts.test:ui: node Scripts/smoke-ui.js && node Scripts/test-accessibility.js && node Scripts/test-experience.js && node Scripts/test-conversation.js && node Scripts/test-sync.js && node Scripts/test-resilience.js
scripts.test:native: python3 Scripts/test-security-boundaries.py && python3 Scripts/test-cli-concurrency.py && python3 Scripts/test-codex-runner.py && python3 Scripts/test-claude-runner.py && ./Scripts/test-notifications.sh
scripts.test:privacy: python3 Scripts/privacy-scan.py && python3 Scripts/test-privacy-scan.py && python3 Scripts/test-security-docs.py
